A soldier that is able to fire may fire at any hex he can see in the flight path and adds 10 to the hex distance, to represent altitude. When fired upon, the airplane is considered a small vehicle in clear terrain. If the airplane is hit and suffers a light penetration or worse, it goes down in flames just off the map edge; otherwise, it is unaffected

paragraphs.11:
Possible random artillery strike. Roll d10 twice, reading the lower digit as the "tens" number and the higher digit as the "ones" number. (This is different from the normal way you read percentile dice in that you do not declare the "tens" die before rolling.)
If the dice result is 25 or less, roll again; reading the dice the same way.
If the second result is 19 or less, use the two dice results together as the hex coordinate in which the artillery hits. 
For example, if the first roll is 13 and the second is 18, hex 1318 (i.e., M-18) is hit. Place a crater marker in a hex hit by the round, unless it is a building hex. Place a rubble marker in the hit building hex. All soldiers are killed and vehicles are knocked out in the hex. If either dice roll is higher than the limits listed above, the artillery strike occurs off the map; your soldiers hear a distant explosion.

A stone bridge can be destroyed in two ways: with a bazooka or with satchel charges._x000B_To destroy it with a bazooka, you must achieve a heavy penetration against it. A soldier, or soldiers, must place two prepared satchel charges in the bridge hex. It takes one turn to set each charge (setting it automatic in Operations). You may then detonate them at your discretion. To detonate them is 1 action, all charges then explode immediately; soldier must be in hex adjacent to bridge._x000B__x000B_A wooden bridge may be destroyed in three ways: with a satchel charge, with a bazooka, or with fuel._x000B_The satchel charge procedure is the same as for the stone bridge, except only one charge is needed._x000B_The bazooka procedure is exactly the same as that for the stone bridge.
To burn the bridge down, a soldier may get fuel from the dump in hex L-10. Each can requires one Port Box. The soldier must then move across the bridge.
